text:
alex: Heads up — noticed invoice-preview up ~2x for tenant t-orion after last routing change. quick trace looks like same request_id emitted twice under different shard keys when client rotates a header mid-session.

rita: ugh. sample?

alex: redacted trace:
```
{"request_id":"req-900","tenant":"t-orion","route_key":"r/fast","client_tag":"c1","tokens":72}
...later...
{"request_id":"req-900","tenant":"t-orion","route_key":"r/fast","client_tag":"c2","tokens":70}
```

cheng: preview agg keys by tenant|client_tag|route_key, ledger dedupes by request_id — mismatch. two fixes: upstream stable billing_key, or preview dedupe by request_id when present.

alex: short-term: change preview to prefer request_id grouping if available. cheaper and no partition change.

rita: agree. add feature flag preview.group_by_request (off default) and canary 5% tenants. also log rate-limited samples of events missing request_id.

cheng: will draft PR. pseudocode in reducer: if e.request_id present -> group by request_id else -> group by existing composite key. include perf test.

metering-bot: Created MET-7801: "preview double-count on client_tag rotation" and attached traces.

alex: telemetry: add metric preview_dedupe_coverage by tenant and alert if preview delta > 12% for top 30 tenants.

rita: long-term: proto add optional billing_key propagated by route-decider or SDKs. migration must be dual-write for kafka. I'll start RFC.

cheng: ok landing canary in ~2h. ping if delta spikes > 15% or CPU climbs.

ops-bot: shadow-deploy scheduled for preview-agg canary at 6945550060.
